candidates.rationale: God brings order and light out of the formless, chaotic void at creation.
Paul declares that God is not a God of disorder but of peace, establishing order in chaotic worship.
Plans fail without counsel, but through many advisers they succeed—turning confusion into clear direction.
God gives wisdom generously to those who lack it, bringing clarity to confusion.
Luke methodically organizes accounts into an orderly narrative so readers may know the certainty of what they've been taught.
